title: Atrinik
description: Atrinik is an open-source role-playing world shaped by its creators and community, with primarily Codex-driven software development and human code contributions welcome.

homepage.title: Free, open-source online role-playing game
homepage.description: Atrinik is a free, open-source online role-playing game. Download Atrinik Classic for Windows; the replacement remains in development.
homepage.heading: Atrinik is a cooperative fantasy game.
homepage.introduction: Explore Atrinik’s isometric islands, ruins, and crystal-lit mysteries with other players. The maintained Classic release is available for Windows; the replacement game remains in development.

privacy.providerEdgeDisclosure: Cloudflare may inject bot/security JavaScript or a dashboard-managed Web Analytics beacon, set strictly necessary cookies, or serve a challenge with its own HTML, scripts, cookies, and CSP. The ordinary page's no-script CSP blocks injected scripts.

identity.heading: A world shaped by its creators. Agent-driven software beneath it.
identity.gameContent: Atrinik's creators shape its maps, quests, dialogue, lore, art and sound with whatever tools serve the work, including AI tools, and review what goes into the game. Every asset keeps its exact credit, source and license.
identity.software: Software is developed primarily through Codex-driven agentic workflows under human direction, review, provenance, and validation. Direct human code contributions are welcome under the same gates.
identity.websiteMediaException: Four website concept images were made by Zoey Rose with OpenAI image generation. They are presentation material, not game content, and are recorded and credited in the site's media inventory.
